mechanism: Verapamil (calcium channel blocker) and chlorthalidone (thiazide-like diuretic) both lower blood pressure and can cause additive hypotensive effects; chlorthalidone-induced hypokalemia may increase verapamil cardiotoxicity risk.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely and serum potassium levels regularly; consider potassium supplementation or concurrent potassium-sparing agent; assess for syncope, dizziness, and arrhythmias.
